qualifications: Claim that the reported interval width is determined by the posterior needs qualification: these are empirical quantiles of a short nonconverged sample. They have Monte Carlo uncertainty and possible failure to represent the posterior; their observed width is not a trustworthy posterior-uncertainty estimate.

ESS effective-independent-draw interpretation concerns the precision of an estimator, commonly a posterior mean, under appropriate stationary sampling assumptions. Rhat 4.29 prevents treating ESS 36 as established posterior precision.
